state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors state they cannot verify that ARC, MMLU, StrategyQA and GSM8k test questions are absent from the training data of the open models used, including Llama-2-70b and Mixtral-8x7b, so they cannot be certain models generalize from easy to hard rather than report memorized answers. They suggest future work evaluate easy-to-hard generalization on private test sets or ones collected after pretraining data cut-offs.
title: Possible test contamination: easy-to-hard results may reflect memorized hard answers
